tagline.en: A 14B interactive world model that turns an image plus a camera path into a controllable video.
tagline.zh: 一个 14B 交互式世界模型，把一张图片加一条相机轨迹变成可控视频。

en: LingBot-World-V2 is an interactive world model that generates video from a starting image while following a camera path you provide, letting you fly a virtual camera through a scene that stays coherent as it unfolds.

WorldFoundry runs the released 14B causal-fast route, reusing common Wan, T5, VAE, scheduler, and geometry code. The official recipe runs across eight GPUs; WorldFoundry also exposes a more compact four-GPU topology with WORLD_SIZE-aligned Ulysses and FSDP, and when it already owns the process group it runs inference directly rather than spawning nested workers.
In WorldFoundry it runs offline-first — no checkpoint downloads during prediction. You give it an image and a camera trajectory, and it produces the corresponding video.
zh: LingBot-World-V2 是一个交互式世界模型，从一张起始图片出发生成视频，同时沿着你提供的相机轨迹推进，让你像操控一台虚拟相机那样穿行于一个在推演中保持连贯的场景。
WorldFoundry 接入了已发布的 14B causal-fast 路径，复用通用的 Wan、T5、VAE、调度器与几何代码。官方配方在八卡上运行；WorldFoundry 还提供了更紧凑的四卡拓扑，采用与 WORLD_SIZE 对齐的 Ulysses 与 FSDP，并在已持有进程组时直接运行推理，而不再派生嵌套 worker。
在 WorldFoundry 中，它以离线优先方式运行——预测过程中不下载 checkpoint。你给它一张图片与一条相机轨迹，它便产出相应的视频。

whenToUse.en: Use it when you want to generate a video from an image while steering a camera path through the scene, and you have multi-GPU hardware to run a 14B interactive world model.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想从一张图片生成视频、同时用相机轨迹在场景中运镜，并具备运行 14B 交互式世界模型的多卡硬件时使用。

notFor.en: It is licensed CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 — not for commercial use. It expects multi-GPU hardware (eight GPUs officially, or a four-GPU compact topology), and the 14B checkpoint must be staged locally.
notFor.zh: 它采用 CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 许可——不可用于商业用途。它需要多卡硬件（官方为八卡，或四卡紧凑拓扑），且 14B checkpoint 需放到本地。
